description: Orchestrates certification course validation, assessment, credential, review, learner, platform, and release checks.

author.purpose: Validate authored curriculum and knowledge content before review.

exam.purpose: Validate curriculum plus assessment and pilot readiness.

certify.purpose: Validate the full certification evidence chain before learner delivery.

learner.purpose: Validate learner-facing academy behavior, progress, enrollment, and accessibility.

platform.purpose: Validate API, runtime, persistence, database, security, and operations controls.

release.purpose: Run the complete production release gate including staging and production readiness.

full.purpose: Run every registered certification toolkit group.
